property_summary: After any play call, the contract's ether balance always equals its pot (each accepted play adds 10 wei to both; a winning play empties both by the same amount), but the mutant only grows the pot by 1 wei per play while collecting 10, so after a losing play the mutant has balance 10 != pot 1.
change_summary: Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot += FEE_AMOUNT;` so the pot grows by the fee amount instead of the ticket value.
